info.title: Igloo API
info.description: HTTP API for the Igloo self-hosted media center. Most JSON endpoints return a shared envelope with error, optional message, and optional data fields. Device bearer tokens issued via Quick Connect or device login (Authorization: Bearer igd_...) are accepted on most routes that accept cookieAuth, except device-management and Quick Connect approval endpoints, which require a cookie session. See each operation's security block for route-specific requirements.

post.description: Quick Connect pairings are kept in this server process's memory. In multi-instance deployments, initiate, approve, and redeem must reach the same instance through sticky routing or a shared store; otherwise cross-instance requests can return 404. Devices poll this endpoint at the advertised interval. A 404 means the code is unknown, expired, or the secret does not match (including after a server restart); the device should request a new code and start over. Approved codes are consumed: the token is returned exactly once.

cookieAuth.name: session
cookieAuth.description: Server-side session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login.

bearerAuth.description: Long-lived device token issued by POST /api/quick-connect/redeem or POST /api/auth/device-login. Tokens are prefixed with igd_.

StaticPath.name: path
StaticPath.description: Relative file path below the configured static directory.

HLSFilenamePath.name: filename
HLSFilenamePath.description: HLS asset name. Valid values are init.mp4 or segment_N.m4s.

TrackIndexPath.name: trackIndex
TrackIndexPath.description: Zero-based index into the movie subtitle rows ordered by stream_index.

OptionalUserSearchQuery.name: q
OptionalUserSearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive name or email substring filter.

PlaybackSessionQuery.name: playback_session
PlaybackSessionQuery.description: UUID that scopes one personal HLS playback session.

avatar.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF image up to 20 MB.

MessageSuccess.description: Successful JSON response with an optional message.

NotificationsListResponse.description: List of notifications visible to the current user with the unread count.

UnreadNotificationCountResponse.description: Unread notification count for the current user.

HLSSegmentResponse.description: Fragmented MP4 initialization file or media segment.

PartialBinaryMediaResponse.description: Partial media file response for a byte range.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Media type cannot be converted or processed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Generated media segment is not ready yet.

QuickConnectRedeemResponse.description: Pairing status; includes the device token once approved.

DevicesListResponse.description: Devices belonging to the current user.

avatar.description: Avatar URL. Empty string removes the avatar.

immich_base_url.description: Optional Immich base URL. Non-null values must use http:// or https://.

jellyfin_base_url.description: Optional Jellyfin base URL. Non-null values must use http:// or https://.

immich_base_url.description: Optional Immich base URL. Blank clears the value; nonblank values must use http:// or https://.

jellyfin_base_url.description: Optional Jellyfin base URL. Blank clears the value; nonblank values must use http:// or https://.

preferred_subtitle_language.description: Two- or three-letter language code, or off.

server_upload_mbps.description: Admin-only server upload bandwidth cap in Mbps.

platform.description: Client platform identifier, e.g. android_tv, android, ios.

code.description: Short code to show the user; entered in the web app to approve the device.

secret.description: Device-held secret required to redeem the code. Never shown to the user.

is_current.description: True when the request was authenticated with this device's token. Always false in the device-list response, which is session-only.

token.description: Bearer device token. Present only when status is approved; returned exactly once.
Bearer device token; returned exactly once.
